scenes.title: Give it a task.
scenes.narration: Give Myelin a task. Astra operates the browser and completes it once.

scenes.title: The run becomes a program.
scenes.narration: Myelin compiles the successful trace into a program, binding new inputs, fresh authentication, and response derived identifiers.

scenes.title: New input. Zero model calls.
scenes.narration: A new invoice runs with zero model calls. These measurements and the successful payment check come from the recorded execution.

scenes.title: Then the app changes.
scenes.narration: When the app renames a request field, Myelin detects a rejected write and resumes visual repair from the checkpoint.

scenes.title: Repair locally. Verify globally.
scenes.narration: Only the broken operation changes. Eight fresh cases check the repair before promotion. The next input again runs without model calls.

scenes.title: Incorrect patches stay out.
scenes.narration: Wrong values, duplicate writes, and unnecessary work are rejected. Even a hosted, staged patch must pass validation before adoption.

scenes.title: An instruction becomes a rule.
scenes.narration: Live steering becomes an explicit rule. The expense program passes below, equal, and above five hundred dollars against eight fresh model references.

scenes.title: Built with inspectable evidence.
scenes.narration: The public repository includes the implementation, development fixes, regression tests, and measured evidence.
